Some of you may have met my wife. But I'd like to introduce her to you all.

Without Evelyn, this event wouldn't be possible. She introduced me to Tesla, and she believed in Elon's vision of autonomous cars long before I ever did. 

She has stood by me through thick and thin, and she's supported me and this Tesla community in ways many of you will never see. She's my heartbeat and my world. Without her, this community wouldn't be what it is today. 

Words can't express my gratitude. I thank God for my wife every day.

Evelyn is the most selfless person I know. She never does things for credit. She takes care of people quietly, whether it's our family, our friends, or someone she barely knows. And she homeschools our four kids with a patience and love I couldn't match on my best day.

This may be news for some of you, but Evelyn has been battling triple-negative breast cancer since August of last year. 

She has endured chemo, surgery, and radiation, and the fight is not over. There have been days that were painful and days that were frightening, and through every one of them she has stayed kind, held onto her faith, and kept showing up for other people. I am honored to serve her and to walk beside her through this.

If you pray, please keep my wife in your prayers. Pray for her healing, her strength, and her peace. It means more to us than you know.

Evelyn, you are my greatest blessing. Thank you for everything you do, seen and unseen. I love you. This community is better because of you, and so am I. 
Proverbs 18:22

她始终站在我一边，以你们许多人从未见过的方式支持我和特斯拉社区。她是我的心跳，我的世界。没有她，这个社区就不会是今天的样子。 

言语无法表达我的感激之情。我每天都为我的妻子感谢上帝。

伊芙琳是我认识的最无私的人。她做事从来不图功劳。她默默地照顾别人，无论是我们的家人、朋友，还是她几乎不认识的人。她以我在最好的一天无法比拟的耐心和爱心在家教育我们的四个孩子。

这对你们中的一些人来说可能是新闻，但伊芙琳自去年八月以来一直在与三阴性乳腺癌作斗争。
